---
name: Codex review
about: Review a generated project version and report what passed or failed
title: "[codex-review] "
labels: review
---

## Version

Required. Record the exact `_vNN` version under review.

## What was generated

Required. List the source, export, notes, manifest, and preview artifacts that were produced.

## What failed

Required. Record export failures, render failures, validation failures, or mismatch findings.

## Screenshots or previews

Required. Attach preview images, screenshots, or comparison images used during review.

## Low-confidence zones

Required. Call out any geometry or assumptions that still need verification.
